title: Diagnostics
need: I need a test or a scan, explained properly
summary: Blood tests, ECGs, ultrasound, echocardiography and ambulatory monitoring on site, with every result reviewed and explained by a clinician, never sent as a page of numbers.
intro: A test is only useful when someone explains what it means for you. Every investigation at Aurevia is requested by a clinician, and every result is reviewed by one before it reaches you. For MRI, CT and the imaging we don't do ourselves, we book appointments with partner centres and bring the report back into your record.
image_alt: An ECG machine printing a heart trace onto paper
for_whom: Patients of Aurevia physicians and specialists
Referrals from outside doctors who want tests done and reported quickly
Anyone who wants a result explained, not just delivered

includes.title: Blood tests
includes.detail: Appointments from 07:45. Most routine results within 24 to 48 hours.

includes.title: Heart tests
includes.detail: Resting ECG, heart-rhythm monitoring from 24 hours to 7 days, 24-hour blood pressure and echocardiography.

includes.title: Ultrasound
includes.detail: Abdominal, pelvic, thyroid and musculoskeletal ultrasound, performed by sonographers and reported by consultants.

includes.title: Imaging with partners
includes.detail: MRI, CT and DEXA arranged nearby, usually within a week, with the report returned to your clinician.

faqs.q: Can I book a test without seeing a doctor?
faqs.a: We ask that a clinician requests each test, so someone is responsible for interpreting it. If your own doctor has written a request, send it with your enquiry.

faqs.q: How will I receive my results?
faqs.a: Through the clinician who requested them: a call, a video appointment or a follow-up visit, with a written copy afterwards.
